trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies in single-player. There is no online trophy and no DLC requirement — the platinum pops as soon as the last one lands.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, at the start of Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. Completing Chapter 1 unlocks it — it pops at the handover into Chapter 2, with the mission What's in the Bag?
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when Chapter 2 ends, after the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops once Ocean Beach and Another Life — the opening two missions of Chapter 4 — are done, closing out Chapter 3.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when you finish Chapter 4's final mission, Starting From Zero.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops for finishing the final mission of the story — just play through to the credits.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 mission Headliners.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Finish the 100% Completion Checklist, found under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion once the story is done. The bar is lenient — roughly 60% true completion: most side quests are not required, collectibles are only partly required, and you need any 70 of 80 challenges. Nothing toward 100% is missable; everything can be done in free-roam after the story. Progress made during the story already counts.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Leonida holds 397 stunts across four kinds — 25 base jumps, 40 knife flights, 130 stunt jumps and 202 flights under bridges — and any 250 of them, in whatever mix you like, earn the trophy. Mix categories freely — under-the-bridge flights are the quickest. Track progress in Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist needs 300 stunts.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, performing a stunt, and winning a race — a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race. Check them in Touchpad > Progress > Activities; most come naturally from the story and the other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. PowerPyx has a full location guide for all 12 ranges and all 42 gold medals; the medals are not considered hard.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Take first place in a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 drone races in total). PowerPyx lists all 14 locations.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. PowerPyx lists 40 unique race locations — any 20 count.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, when you have met Cal, he texts you a fishing spot (purple map icon). Follow his fishing questline and beat him in a fishing challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game (called 'Video Games' in-game). Tenebrae Lux and Street Trash III run on the home TV, as does Time Jackers Rewind; the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is out on arcade machines around the world. Finish all levels of one game once — you do not need every challenge.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline (Lucia only). It is marked automatically in Chapter 3: Andy calls, then texts her home address in Belville. Complete all 5 quests — Puff Puff Pass, Read the Label, Peach!, Pay the Cellerica Fee and Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3). All quests remain available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline. It is marked automatically in Chapter 1; after the mission Island Dreams he calls, and a green 'KR' marker appears for him in Key Lento. He sends you treasure diving at 7 shipwrecks — find the underwater treasures with the metal detector and bring them back. He is temporarily unavailable during Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2–3, so nothing here is missable.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete the 5 quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All remain available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers. Only certain questlines count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward it. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete; PowerPyx notes more strangers are still being discovered. All remain available in free-roam after the story. One strand is time-sensitive: Yago's Chapter 3 street race shows an hourglass marker, so run it the moment it appears — and save first.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline, 'Randy's Wish List'. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso and unlock the Key Cloner. Randy wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage (green 'RK' icon, west Vice City); scan cars with the WAiNK app to check the wishlist, and look around Vice Beach / Ocean Beach, where they are often parked or driving. All can be done after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline (Jason only). It is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Destroy the Synthetic Labs (purple markers, quest 'Take Out Kitty Litter'), then Tyrone gives the second quest 'Spin On This'. All available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations (Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations). Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts +2. The final meditation needs both characters playable together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2). The 100% checklist only asks for 15 of the 18 meditations.
trophies.missable_note: POTENTIALLY MISSABLE — the only trophy PowerPyx and GTABase flag. One meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen in the morning and walks out to the balcony. Follow her and choose 'Accept'. It is not marked as a Meditation Spot, and PowerPyx says it is still unclear whether it is required for the trophy — do it to be safe, and keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Finish Bret Vogel's questline (Jason only). After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Bret texts Jason and marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. Bret marks hunting spots (purple icons); hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. Bret hands over a unique hunting rifle, the Killtelligence SM-69, during the first quest. It is still unclear exactly which animal unlocks the trophy — PowerPyx is still confirming it.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. PowerPyx has a guide to all 18 card set locations.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1): 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, among others — there are well over 100, so any 100 count.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. For 100% you need 70 of 80, so this pops along the way. Track them in Progress > Challenges and pick the easiest ones — there are 10 more than needed, so you can skip the hardest.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Get to 4 stars while your partner is with you, then shake the cops and drop back to zero heat. Available once you can free-roam as Jason and Lucia together (after Coffee Break, Chapter 2); call your partner with Right + Triangle. Cause chaos to reach 4 stars, then escape on a fast motorcycle — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia (Kelly County) works well, because cops and the helicopter struggle there. It also pops naturally during That's Where The Money Is (Chapter 4), since bank vault robberies trigger 4-star wanted levels.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Hit three robbery targets in a row while your partner is along, keeping the flashing wanted level alive the whole time. Available after Coffee Break (Chapter 2). Stay at the flashing wanted level — not the solid red heat level — while looting 3 robbery targets in a row; bring armor, sticky bombs and healing. A good spot is North Vice City, which holds three jewelry stores (unlocked after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs). The pop is delayed — about 30 seconds after leaving the 3rd shop; if it doesn't pop, hit a 4th shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Use the WAiNK app (hold Up to open it, then R1 to scan) and scan vehicles as they pass on a busy road — you only need to scan them, not drive them. There are 557 vehicles at launch; for 100% you need to scan 200 of the 277 base models, so this comes automatically.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: While aiming, trigger Combat Focus (L3 + R3) and take down five enemies before the focus bar runs out. It slows time and highlights weak spots, draining the purple focus bar. Buff focus first (food, drinks, washing up at home) and use Adrenaline to extend it; line up 5 enemies — gang operations work well — and use a full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus levels up by playing shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and landing headshots; you will likely reach Focus Level 4 naturally.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked to a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — not one parked on the airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get inside, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip and take off. Fly 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport before it pops.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Grab a Rhino tank from Mile Zero Air Station — the airfield on the island in Mariana County's far south-west. The Rhinos are parked on the base's southern side. Drive in through the gate (or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), get in a tank and shoot enemies until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Pull off a jewelry-store robbery without ever being spotted. First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks jewelry store robberies (green icons). Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun and never force it — forcing the door sets the alarm off. Inside, look in the back room for a note carrying the safe's combination, then open the safe and take what's inside. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Start with That's Where The Money Is, the Chapter 4 optional mission whose 'Wait at the Cafe' beat teaches the vault-robbery loop: follow a security van to its bank, get inside while the vault stands open, and have your partner carry a bag out. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (purple icons). Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle. There are 8 large bank jobs; 100% needs all 8.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in That's Where The Money Is (Chapter 4): robbing a large bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck. Earlier method: block an armored truck near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back door, then escape the red heat radius (you can buy sticky bombs at Yasmani's shop once his quests are done).
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the map is clear. PowerPyx has a guide to the best plane for unfogging.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total; you only need one per gang, but 100% needs all 39. They show as yellow icons when you go near them, and many are marked automatically by story progress. Track per-gang counts in Progress > Gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed by a published guide. PowerPyx lists this trophy's unlock method as currently unknown — the description hints at a cocktail overlooking Ocean Beach, but no guide has pinned down the exact spot or trigger yet. Check the linked guide for updates rather than following an unverified method.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed by a published guide. PowerPyx lists this trophy's unlock method as currently unknown — the description points to smashing out of a vehicle showroom, but no guide has pinned down which showroom or the exact trigger yet. Check the linked guide for updates rather than following an unverified method.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a gang operation): the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun 'Gutterball Moreland 850' on a table in the room's north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs, bought at Ammu-Nation). It unlocks during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. You do not need all 3 in one visit — the robbery icon respawns, so you can come back for the rest; it is not missable. The trophy pops after you escape the police.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength in Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). Available after Coffee Break (Chapter 2), when you can switch characters. Work out at fitness clubs (filter Map > Activities) — always bring your partner (Right + Triangle), because while one trains the other completes training too, doubling progress. Home workouts work too once the story is done.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Rack up 500 profile-affecting actions — robberies, fights, escapes and the like all count. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) to see a demon face whenever an action counts. Profiles range from Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes) to Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable (permanent if you keep up excessive violence). It comes passively from robberies and fights; if it is the last trophy left, farm it by running over civilians and cops — note cops shoot on sight more at Psycho/Irredeemable.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed by a published guide. PowerPyx still marks this one unknown; the going guess ties it to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. No verified method exists yet — check the linked guide for updates rather than following an unverified method.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed by a published guide. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from a UFO questline. No verified method exists yet — check the linked guide for updates rather than following an unverified method.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Not yet confirmed by a published guide. PowerPyx still marks this one unknown; the going guess is kicking enemies off while riding a motorcycle. No verified method exists yet — check the linked guide for updates rather than following an unverified method.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Then hit banks and Payday Loans for marked bills and sell them on through a fence — Yasmani in Vice City offers the best rate. The $250,000 is cumulative across robberies; bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 per robbery once unlocked in Chapter 4.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Run $100,000 through Leonida's shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest — the most expensive items. Shops include 15 electronics stores, 24 Ammu-Nations, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays and 14 mod shops, plus 11 tattoo studios, 18 hair & beauty salons, 17 footwear stores and 67 clothing stores.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (total $160,000; the 4 story garages don't count). They unlock for purchase after Daily Driver, the Chapter 2 mission where you steal the Crawler for Moses, via the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone. Robberies are the quickest money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4. PowerPyx lists all 12 garage locations.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). Buy garages first (see Little Boxes) — each adds parking spots for registrations. Bring stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register; at first he only takes vehicles with no tracker fitted; once Chapter 3 opens up, Pay 'n' Sprays can register cars carrying Standard Trackers too. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
